metadata.description: Claude Code mods bundled with sccs. Installed by `sccs doctor install` when listed under doctor.bundled_mods.

plugins.name: paste-lens
plugins.description: Puts a long paste straight back into the prompt box instead of the collapsed [Pasted text #N] placeholder, so it can be read and edited before it is sent. Marks text with Shift and the arrow keys, so a block is deleted or replaced at once.
